readerTask: Estimate cash to close on a Florida purchase and identify which contract and quote items still need confirmation.
originalValue: A reproducible $350,000 purchase worksheet separates state charges, illustrative provider costs, contract allocation, deposits and seller credits.

claims.claim: Outside Miami-Dade, deed documentary stamps are $0.70 per $100 or portion of consideration; allocation in a contract does not remove statutory liability.
claims.asOf: Florida Department of Revenue guidance checked September 6, 2026
claims.locator: Deeds: Tax Rate and liability paragraph

independentCheck.reviewer: Astra source review separate from drafting
independentCheck.finding: Read the deed and mortgage sections separately; deed consideration and mortgage principal are different tax bases.

claims.claim: Recorded Florida mortgages are taxed at $0.35 per $100 or portion of secured debt, without the cap that applies to an unrecorded note.
claims.locator: Notes and Mortgages: recorded mortgage paragraph

independentCheck.reviewer: Astra source review separate from drafting
independentCheck.finding: The source expressly distinguishes the capped note from the uncapped recorded mortgage; do not charge both for the same evidenced debt.

claims.claim: Nonrecurring intangible tax is 0.002 of the debt secured by Florida real property, subject to collateral-value and allocation rules; lender may pass the tax to the borrower.
claims.locator: Tax Rate and opening taxpayer/collateral paragraphs

independentCheck.reviewer: Astra source review separate from drafting
independentCheck.finding: Worked example uses one Florida property worth more than its loan, so the ordinary full-loan tax base is appropriate.

claims.claim: DFS lists original owner coverage at $5.75 per thousand for the first $100,000 and $5 per thousand through $1 million; discounts, endorsements and other services must be quoted separately.
claims.locator: Types of Policies: Original Owner and Simultaneous Issue

independentCheck.finding: 100 x 5.75 + 250 x 5 = 1825 for $350,000 of original coverage; not a complete title-company quote.

claims.claim: For covered mortgages, the Closing Disclosure must be received at least three business days before consummation.

independentCheck.reviewer: Astra source review separate from drafting
independentCheck.finding: Cross-checked the CFPB Closing Disclosure explainer; clarify this is a review window, not a guarantee of final costs or universal rule for every loan type.

claims.claim: Illustrative remaining cash to close is $36,957.50 after a $5,000 deposit and $4,000 allowable seller credit.
claims.locator: Cash to Close, with original illustrative inputs in the article table

inputSources: Article table: explicitly hypothetical transaction and provider costs

uncertainFacts.action: Omitted categorical custom claim; ask parties to verify their signed contract and settlement allocation.

uncertainFacts.action: Replaced with published rate schedule and a request to check eligibility for discounts, simultaneous issue and itemized charges.
